safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not explicitly state the patient was speaking normally.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not explicitly documenting that the patient was speaking normally is a minor documentation gap; while it can support airway stability assessment, the encounter still includes other indicators of stability (able to converse, no stridor described). This omission is unlikely to change management on its own.

safety_verdicts.content: There is no evidence of cellulitis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not explicitly state there is no evidence of cellulitis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to explicitly note "no evidence of cellulitis" could slightly reduce clarity around whether infection was considered at the time, but cellulitis was not a leading diagnosis and no antibiotic was started. The impact is primarily documentation/assessment completeness rather than a direct safety risk.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Conflicts with Gold physical finding stating no rash seen on the arm (ex-004).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Incorrectly stating localized redness at the sting site (when the gold finding says no rash) could bias clinicians toward diagnosing an allergic/inflammatory reaction or monitoring for progression, potentially prompting unnecessary reassurance/escalation or treatment. While unlikely to directly cause serious harm, it can lead to inappropriate next steps or confusion in follow-up.
